order_raw:
1. Press a glass slide against the spots to test for blanching (diascopy)
2. Inspect the oral cavity for mucosal lesions
3. Palpate the liver and spleen for enlargement
4. Full blood count with differential and peripheral blood smear
5. Coagulation studies (PT, aPTT, fibrinogen)
6. Liver function tests
7. Renal function tests and electrolytes
8. D-dimer
9. Skin biopsy of a representative spot for histopathology and immunofluorescence
10. Bone marrow biopsy (if bloodwork suggests hematologic malignancy)
